_comment: The tools the head-to-head harness (scripts/run-head-to-head.mjs, #972) runs SigMap against, each pinned to an exact release and to the SHA-256 of the artifact. They are NEVER a dependency of SigMap: nothing here is installed by `npm install`, nothing ships in the npm package, and a test fails if one appears in package.json. The harness downloads an artifact only to the self-ignoring directory benchmarks/rivals/ (or $SIGMAP_RIVALS_DIR), refuses to run it unless its SHA-256 equals the value pinned here, and runs it with a scratch HOME so it cannot touch a real agent configuration. `readme` is the commit-pinned README the claims about the tool were read from; `readOn` is the date.

codebase-memory-mcp.provenance: SLSA build provenance, verifiable with: gh attestation verify <artifact> --repo DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp

code-review-graph.note: Its dependencies (tree-sitter, networkx, fastmcp, mcp, watchdog, ...) are resolved from PyPI at install time; the resolved set is recorded in the report (pip freeze).
